all_candidates.topic: Is new UPI merchant charge fair for small businesses?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government and NPCI notified a 0.4% Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) on person-to-merchant UPI transactions above ₹2,000, effective October 15, 2026, with details issued September 14-15, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should all UPI transactions, P2P and P2M, remain free?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government clarified on September 15, 2026, that person-to-person (P2P) UPI transactions will continue to be free, irrespective of the transaction value.

all_candidates.topic: Was postponing the CTET exam a fair decision for students?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The CBSE issued a public notice on September 14, 2026, revising the CTET 2026 examination schedule from September 6 to December 12 and 13.

all_candidates.topic: Should Delhi's PG accommodations face mandatory, frequent safety inspections?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Following a building collapse in Satya Niketan on September 7, 2026, that killed seven, the Delhi High Court directed the MCD to inspect all PG hostels within a week.

all_candidates.topic: Are recent Oracle layoffs in India justified due to AI integration?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Oracle began a fresh round of layoffs in India, primarily impacting product engineering teams, as part of a global restructuring that started on September 14, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should domestic fuel prices be decoupled from global crude swings?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Fuel prices across India remained largely stable in the week ending September 16, 2026, even as Brent crude prices topped $108 per barrel.

all_candidates.topic: Should social media platforms resist quick government takedown orders?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Instagram blocked posts by Article 14 on September 8, 2026, and Maktoob Media on September 10, 2026, following government orders, highlighting concerns about immediate online censorship.

all_candidates.topic: Is AI-driven hiring masking a broader slowdown in India's job market?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Naukri JobSpeak report, released on September 7, 2026, showed India's white-collar hiring surged 14% year-over-year in August due to AI, contrasting with an overall recruitment fall of 12% in July.

all_candidates.topic: Are stricter rules against e-commerce 'dark patterns' needed?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government amended Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules on September 10, 2026, to tighten norms governing deceptive design practices or 'dark patterns,' effective January 1, 2027.

all_candidates.topic: Should e-commerce sites always show 30-day prior pricing?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government's amended e-commerce rules, announced on September 10, 2026, mandate platforms to display the lowest price offered in the preceding 30 days when a price reduction is announced.

all_candidates.topic: Should companies transparently report AI's impact on job numbers?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Wipro announced on September 10, 2026, that AI productivity gains have freed up capacity equivalent to 20,000 employees.

all_candidates.topic: Will FASTag portability significantly improve highway convenience?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari launched the 'One Tag' facility for FASTag portability on September 11, 2026, allowing vehicle owners to link existing FASTags to new bank accounts.

all_candidates.topic: Is a 25-day LPG refill interval adequate for rural families?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Union Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas confirmed on September 7, 2026, that the LPG refill booking interval has been cut to 25 days for rural consumers as well.

all_candidates.topic: Is an AI-agent registry for UPI payments a good idea?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) announced on September 10, 2026, its plans to develop a registry for AI agents that will enable them to transact on UPI.

all_candidates.topic: Is India sufficiently preparing its workforce for advanced AI roles?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Microsoft's 'Frontier Professional' study, reported on September 12, 2026, found that 32% of Indian AI users qualify as 'Frontier Professionals,' double the global average.

all_candidates.topic: Should states prioritize long-term power contracts over spot purchases?
all_candidates.news_anchor: On September 16, 2026, Kerala's Chief Minister stated the government is holding discussions with states and power companies to formulate long-term contracts to resolve the current electricity crisis.

all_candidates.topic: Should India mandate more EV component localisation now?
all_candidates.news_anchor: New EV localisation rules, requiring stricter domestic manufacturing for traction motors in electric buses and trucks, took effect from September 1, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Is digital licensing for pesticides a beneficial change?
all_candidates.news_anchor: From September 15, 2026, India mandated a fully digital licensing and record-keeping system for the entire pesticide industry, ending paper-based compliance.

all_candidates.topic: Is mandatory e-invoicing for higher turnover businesses effective?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Rule 2 regarding mandatory e-invoicing for businesses with over ₹5 crore annual aggregate turnover, and a 30-day limit for those above ₹10 crore, was highlighted as a current compliance requirement on September 8, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Has India's decade of inflation targeting been successful?
all_candidates.news_anchor: On September 7, 2026, India marked a decade of inflation targeting as a formal policy framework of the Reserve Bank of India.
